notes: Technical report on MiniMax Sparse Attention (MSA), not a safety/system card. No safety, alignment, refusal, jailbreak, bias, toxicity, or dangerous-capability section or results. All reported benchmarks are capability (MMLU, GPQA, math/code, multimodal, RULER/HELMET, agent PPL); skipped under pilot safety-only evalResults rule. Disclosures describe the paper's 109B MoE experiment models (MSA-PT/MSA-CPT) that validate MSA; MiniMax-M3 is named only as a public production release powered by MSA, without separate M3 eval numbers. '1M context' appears as an efficiency measurement point, not a stated product context-window limit. 'alignment' in the text means KL indexer training, not AI alignment.
